strategy.extendedWindow: 30 days only with a live direct destination
strategy.coverageGoal: maximum practical coverage; never claim inaccessible or blocked listings were searched

nextRun.notes: Resume authenticated Instahyre, deeper Cutshort and YC pagination, and blocked Internshala detail pages. Then repeat the complete 24-hour LinkedIn Jobs matrix, fresh normal-post queries, broad portals, employer ATS pages, missing-listing trails, and the full active-link audit.

sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Repeat the complete 17-role-family by four-location matrix at starts 0, 25, and 50, then continue selected high-yield queries beyond start 50
sourceLanes.notes: The evening public LinkedIn Jobs sweep traversed 17 role families, four target locations, and starts 0, 25, and 50: all 204 query-location-page combinations succeeded, including the morning Noida Growth Analyst checkpoint. Ten fresh direct listings passed verification and were added: Nutrabay Analytics Engineer, ClanX Data Engineer Intern, Target Data Analyst under a new repost ID, CSK Technologies Data Analyst Intern, Cuemath Operations and Analytics Associate, Counterpoint Research Associate, FRND Strategy Analyst, SmartHelio Junior Marketing Analyst, Origin Supply Chain Planning Intern, and Precision AQ Reporting Analyst. The final audit archived Rama Vision, ProBuddy, Workfall, and Palette Hire after each changed to no longer accepting applications.

sourceLanes.label: Normal LinkedIn hiring posts
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: fresh original employee, recruiter, and founder posts using reporting, RevOps, risk, data engineering, fresher, graduate, referral, SQL, and Power BI variants after indexing refreshes
sourceLanes.notes: Normal LinkedIn employee, recruiter, founder, and company posts were searched independently using fresher, junior, intern, SQL, Power BI, analytics, reporting, and target-city combinations. Discoverable candidates were one month or more old, older edited posts, or comment and DM-gated third-party posts without a current employer destination. No fresh original post passed both the current-post and usable-route gates.

sourceLanes.label: Company careers and ATS pages
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Fresh Workday, Taleo, SmartRecruiters, Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, and company-hosted pages, then canonicalize the newly added startup and LinkedIn roles where an exact employer requisition appears
sourceLanes.notes: The canonicalization and ATS pass searched exact employer destinations for Nutrabay, FRND, Origin, ClanX, Cuemath, SmartHelio, TopGrep, Wissen, Target, and other new listings, plus fresh Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, and Workday queries. No exact canonical employer page displaced the verified direct LinkedIn or Cutshort route. Search results for TopGrep exposed a different senior Wellfound role and were not substituted.

sourceLanes.label: Startup boards
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Authenticated Instahyre traversal, deeper Cutshort pagination, and current YC company boards, then recheck previously unavailable Wellfound IDs for state reversals
sourceLanes.notes: The oldest incomplete lane was resumed first across Wellfound, Cutshort, Instahyre, and YC. TopGrep Junior Power BI Developer and Wissen Technology Data Analyst passed direct Cutshort verification and were added. Instahyre remained inaccessible or generic, YC did not expose a suitable current target-location early-career role, and the previously rejected Wellfound endpoints were not republished. The lane remains partial for authenticated and deeper pagination.

sourceLanes.label: Specialist and early-career portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Additional Internshala pages for BI, MIS, research, risk, and operations analytics once direct detail access returns; then Unstop and Hirist detail pages
sourceLanes.notes: Internshala, Unstop, Hirist, and specialist variants were searched independently. Internshala detail access remained blocked by robots, the visible Unstop Data Analyst result had a July deadline, and Hirist results were old or required two to twelve years. The two verified Cutshort additions are owned by the startup lane. No additional specialist listing passed the freshness and direct-route gates.

sourceLanes.label: Broad job portals
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Indeed in an authenticated session or canonicalize employer destinations, then retry Foundit and Naukri client-rendered detail extraction
sourceLanes.notes: Indeed, Foundit, and Naukri were searched for fresh fresher, junior, internship, and zero-to-two-year analytics variants in the target cities. Accessible results were generic result pages, stale indexed copies, blocked client-rendered pages, or roles already represented by a better direct destination. No broad-portal discovery independently passed the current-detail and live-route gates.
